t: You're on St John's Hill, a street in the London Borough of Wandsworth. This is where Louisa Sarah Bevington was born, in 1845. She became an English poet, essayist and anarchist, and she died in 1895. Among the people who attended her funeral was Peter Kropotkin, the better-known anarchist thinker, which says something about the esteem in which her comrades held her. So as you walk this ordinary stretch of road, think of a poet and political writer who started life right here.
